data.one_liner: A Flutter booking calendar widget with conflict calculation and real-time streams.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable booking calendar widget that allows users to pick time slots, handle schedule conflicts, and upload bookings in real-time. It integrates with data streams such as Firebase Firestore to display live availability.
use_when: You need to build an appointment or reservation system in Flutter
You are using Firebase Firestore or similar stream-based backends for bookings
You want a calendar UI that calculates time slot conflicts automatically
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose event calendar without booking and time slot features
You do not use Dart streams for managing booking availability
strengths: Quick setup with minimal required parameters
Handles time slot conflict calculations automatically
Highly customizable with various styling and localization options
weaknesses: Requires custom adapter functions to map stream results to date-time ranges
Limited documentation outside of the provided Firebase example
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the dependency and implementing stream fetch, upload, and data conversion functions (e.g., with Firebase Firestore).
data.minimal_example:
BookingCalendar(
  getBookingStream: getBookingStream,
  uploadBooking: uploadBooking,
  convertStreamResultToDateTimeRanges: convertStreamResultToDateTimeRanges,
)
